title: Wire Critical Orphan Engines — AI/Safety/Physics MCP Exposure

close_out_log.note: All 10 AI Core engines confirmed MCP-exposed under alternative action names. See knowledge/wiki/architecture/u-aiw01-close-out-spec-vs-actual.md for the spec→actual mapping. Renaming actions to spec names would regress ~150 downstream references — keep actual names, document mapping.

rationale: Audit revealed 837 engines (36%) orphaned from MCP dispatcher system. 70 critical engines in AI/Safety/Physics domains cannot be invoked via standard tool dispatch. This milestone wires high-value engines to make PRISM's advanced AI capabilities accessible.
